intro: Your active bids and reserved watches, together. Every amount and status comes from the service that owns it.
auctionHeld: Bidding is on hold. Refresh to check whether it can resume.
allocationDenied: Order allocation was refused and is held for review.
payment_unknown: Payment status is uncertain. Wait for confirmation before trying to pay again.
pendingNotice: Pending or unconfirmed reservation requests stay in Checkout until Orders acknowledges them.
emptyBids: No active bids yet. Find a watch and join a live auction.
emptyReservationPage: No current reservations on this page
unavailable: Temporarily unavailable. Your activity has not been changed.
signIn: Sign in to see your activity
accessDenied: Your current account cannot use buyer actions.
signInBody: This private workspace only shows your own bids and reservations.
paymentUnavailable: Payment and delivery are not available yet. This is not a paid order.
resultsUnavailable: Final auction results will appear when auction closing is available.
more: More activity is available in the owning service.
legacyMaximumUnavailable: New maximum bids are temporarily unavailable. You can still check an earlier bid receipt.
privacy: Only you can see your ceiling. An automatic response must beat a challenger by a full increment. Equal ceilings have no earlier priority. You may raise an accepted ceiling, but cannot lower or remove it.
quoted: Review the preview, then confirm your private maximum.
recoveryUnavailable: Resolve the pending request on the original auction before placing another bid.
quoteUnavailable: A current fee preview is unavailable. No bid was submitted.
quoteExpired: The preview expired. Review a new preview before confirming.
quoteMissing: The original fee preview is unavailable.
quoteBasis: Fee preview at your maximum, not a payment or a final auction price.
previewLimitBody: The lowest available maximum exceeds the fee preview limit. You can still view the auction and check earlier requests.
sampleFeePolicy: Simulated fee preview. The buyer fee is 3% in addition to the watch price.
acknowledged: Maximum accepted. The displayed price may be below your ceiling.
invalidAmount: Enter a positive amount within the preview limit, with up to two decimals and no thousands separators.
denied: Bid not accepted. Review the auction's current price, access and end time.
stale: The auction changed. Refresh before confirming a new maximum.
uncertain: Submission could not be confirmed. Retry the same request to check its outcome; do not assume it was rejected.
offline: You are offline. Bids cannot be placed or queued.
feeReviewed: Fee review confirmed. No bid was sent.
retryBody: Refresh to check current access and source records. No action has been confirmed.
browseBody: Explore watches or choose another view.
allocationPending: Allocation is pending. Check this result for updates.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Showing the last confirmed answer.
maximumUnavailable: Stored ceiling unavailable. Refresh before raising it.
otherAuctionRecovery: Recover a request for another auction
previousAuctionRecovery: This listing has a replacement auction. Check your request for the previous auction to continue.
bidRangeExhausted: This auction has reached its bidding limit.
countdown: Time remaining at last server update
restartActivity: Return to the first page to see the current activity.
highValueContact: A verified contact is required for bids at or above
payment_pending: Payment is pending. Review the order for updates.
payment_paid_held: Payment is confirmed and held. Review the order for fulfilment updates.
payment_unpaid: Payment is due. Review the order for the current payment instructions.
payment_unpaid_released: The order ended unpaid and the watch commitment was released. Review the order history.
payment_released: The sale is complete and funds were released. Review the order history.
auctionHelpBody: If allocation is pending, refresh here to check whether your order is ready. If payment is uncertain, open your order and check its status before trying to pay again.
checkAllocation: Check if your order is ready
noEarlierBidReceipts: No recorded decisions were found for this auction. If you lost a response, refresh to check again.
